title: Queue-aware merge-when-green
goal: merge-when-green queues a PR on a merge-queue branch and reports only a real merge.
acceptance: A committed test fails before the change: queued without strategy, merged after the queue, exit 4 when it leaves the queue
Without a merge queue the existing tests pass unchanged
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: one queue branch in the merge loop and one test.
